# remittance_advice

Received payer letters and revisions; read the letter body for commercial designations.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="remittance_advice", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="remittance_advice", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Explicit identifier relationships

- `remittance_id` references a `remittances` record ID when present. See `DB-remittances`.

Commercial references can require entity, period or issuer matching. An ID relationship does not imply that every related record repeats the same case_id.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `payer_letter` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Public payer letter, including commercial designations and revision information. |
| `payer_letter.designations` | array | Nested output only | Designations: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `payer_letter.remittance_reference` | string | Nested output only | Remittance reference: commercial reference, which may differ from the storage id. Match using the documented reference field and business context. |
| `payer_letter.revision` | integer | Nested output only | Revision of this document or business record; inspect its status and applicability as well as the number. |
| `payer_letter.status` | string | Nested output only | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `READY`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `received_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Received minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `remittance_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in remittances. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `revision` | integer | Top-level filter | Revision of this document or business record; inspect its status and applicability as well as the number. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `READY`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
